newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Intel launches Irish optical engineering society.
newsitem.headline: Intel launches Irish optical engineering society.

text.p: Intel Ireland on Thursday launched an optical engineering society which it said will give Ireland an improved competitive position internationally in the critically important area of optical engineering.
Intel said the new society, the Optical Engineering Society of Ireland (OESI), is committed to meeting the needs of Irish industry in all areas of optical engineering.

"It will promote networking between industry...and those involved in research and development...as well as providing a link to specialists world-wide and direct access to huge resources in the field of optics," Intel said in a statement.
It said OESI was a chapter of the International Society for Optical Engineering with 11,000 members in 68 countries.
The society caters for a wide range of specialisations including optronics, photonics, holography and the optics of lenses, mirrors and lasers.
